system: SMITHING MINIGAME (forge temperature + hammer-timing craft) — Game-1-modular/Crafting-subdisciplines/smithing.py + core/difficulty_calculator.py + core/reward_calculator.py + engine glue in core/game_engine.py
summary: Two-channel dexterity minigame launched after the player grid-places materials matching a smithing recipe. Channel 1: temperature — decays every 100ms, SPACE fans it up, goal is to sit inside a difficulty-narrowed ideal band centered on 70°C. Channel 2: hammer — an indicator oscillates across a 400px logical bar; clicking STRIKE scores a binned 0-100 timing score multiplied by an exponential temperature multiplier. Complete REQUIRED_HITS strikes before the timer expires to succeed; timeout fails and burns a difficulty-scaled 30-90% of materials. Performance = average of per-strike final scores (0-100); reward calculator normalizes ((avg × 1.2-if-final-temp-ideal) / 120, +0.10 first-try) to a 0-1 score that maps to quality tier (Normal→Legendary), bonus%, and stat multiplier, all capped by a difficulty-driven max multiplier (1.0-2.5x). Difficulty is pure material points (sum of tier×qty, linear, no diversity) linearly interpolated across SMITHING_PARAMS between 1 and 80 points. INT stat softens hammer speed/temp decay/time limit at launch without touching difficulty_points (rewards unaffected).
player_facing: Placement phase: player drags materials onto a tier-sized grid (T1=3x3, T2=5x5, T3=7x7, T4=9x9) at a smithing station; exact pattern match vs placements JSON (bounding-box normalized, so position on grid doesn't matter) selects the recipe (interactive_crafting.py:625-792)

Minigame opens as a 1000x700 forge overlay, right-aligned, with a metadata splash showing difficulty tier/points, time limit, required strikes, temp range; minigame update is PAUSED while this overlay blocks (game_engine.py:9119-9143, 8556-8558)

Moment-to-moment loop: watch vertical furnace gauge (0-100 temp, flames change color by temp), tap SPACE to fan heat up while it constantly decays; watch hammer indicator sweep back and forth over the anvil; click the STRIKE button when the indicator is over the center perfect-zone lines (game_engine.py:727-728, 2482-2486, 9398-9467)
Feedback: strike counter 'Strikes: n/N' with progress bar, last-6 strike scores color-coded (gold >=100), countdown timer turns yellow <20s and pulsing red <10s (game_engine.py:9438-9509)
Win: land REQUIRED_HITS strikes before timer hits 0 → 'Crafted <quality_tier> item with +X% bonus!' and item enters inventory with crafted stats + rarity (smithing.py:378-379, 445-457)
Fail: timer expires → "Time's up!", materials partially destroyed (30-90% by difficulty), failure notification (smithing.py:230-231; game_engine.py:8944-8951)
Abandon: ESC once warns 'Press ESC again to abandon craft (materials lost)', second ESC within 1.5s cancels (game_engine.py:709-726)

Skill buffs (quicken → slower temp decay; empower/elevate → flat quality bonus) and titles (smithingTime/smithingQuality) are announced in console at launch (game_engine.py:4226-4243; smithing.py:59-61)
INT stat visibly eases the minigame: slower hammer, slower temp decay, longer timer (game_engine.py:4303-4343)
mechanics: STATE: temperature (starts 50.0), hammer_position (0-400, starts 0), hammer_direction (±1), hammer_hits, hammer_scores[], time_left=time_limit, per-strike stats dict (smithing.py:63-92, 161-191)

TEMP DECAY: every 100ms wall-clock (pygame ticks), temperature -= TEMP_DECAY / (1.0 + speed_bonus), floored at 0; speed_bonus = buff_time_bonus (quicken skill + smithingTime title), it slows decay, NOT the timer (smithing.py:56-59, 210-219)
FAN: SPACE press → temperature = min(100, temperature + TEMP_FAN_INCREMENT) (smithing.py:233-236; keybind game_engine.py:727-728)

HAMMER SWEEP: each update() call moves hammer_position += direction × HAMMER_SPEED; bounces at 0 and 400 (HAMMER_BAR_WIDTH); stops advancing once hits==REQUIRED_HITS. NOTE: pixels-per-frame, not dt-scaled — framerate-coupled at 60 FPS (smithing.py:221-226; core/config.py:16)
TIMER: time_left -= dt (seconds); at <=0 → end(completed=False, "Time's up!") (smithing.py:228-231)

STRIKE TIMING SCORE (binned): distance = |hammer_position - 200|; w = 200/9 ≈ 22.22px; score 100 if d<=0.3w, 90 if <=1w, 80 if <=2w, 70 if <=3w, 60 if <=4w, 50 if <=6w, 30 if <=9w, else 0 (smithing.py:238-286)
TEMP MULTIPLIER: 1.0 inside [TEMP_IDEAL_MIN, TEMP_IDEAL_MAX]; else deviation from nearest band edge → mult = e^(-0.0433 × deviation²) (0.5 at 4° off), clamped to [0.1, 1.0] (smithing.py:288-320)

STRIKE FINAL SCORE = round(timing_score × temp_mult) as int; appended to hammer_scores; hammer_hits += 1; categorized into perfect(>=100)/excellent(>=90)/good(>=70)/fair(>=50)/poor(>=30)/miss stats (smithing.py:322-376)
WIN CONDITION: hammer_hits reaches REQUIRED_HITS → end(completed=True); only failure mode is timeout (or double-ESC abandon at engine level) (smithing.py:378-379)

END (success): avg_hammer_score = mean(hammer_scores) [0-100]; in_ideal_range = final temperature inside band at end-moment; earned_points = sum(scores), max_points = REQUIRED_HITS × 100 (smithing.py:400-414)

REWARD PIPELINE (0-1 performance): base_performance = min(1.0, avg_hammer_score × (1.2 if temp_in_ideal else 1.0) / 120); if attempt==1: base_performance = min(1.0, +0.10) and first_try_bonus_applied; quality tier from thresholds; bonus_pct = int(performance × (max_multiplier-1) × 20); stat_multiplier = 1 + bonus_pct/100; first_try_eligible = attempt==1 AND performance>=0.50 (reward_calculator.py:167-227, 123-160, 107-120)
MAX MULTIPLIER BY DIFFICULTY: normalized = clamp01((difficulty_points-1)/(80-1)); max_multiplier = 1.0 + normalized × 1.5 (range 1.0-2.5) (reward_calculator.py:81-104, 28-31)
QUALITY BUFF: after reward calc, bonus += int(buff_quality_bonus × 10) percentage points (empower/elevate/pierce buffs + smithingQuality title) (smithing.py:434-438; game_engine.py:4230-4243)
RESULT DICT: success, score(=avg 0-100), bonus, quality_tier, stat_multiplier, temp_in_ideal, difficulty_points, first_try_eligible, earned_points, max_points, stats (smithing.py:445-460)

DIFFICULTY: difficulty_points = Σ tier×quantity over recipe inputs (linear TIER_POINTS 1/2/3/4, min 1.0, tier looked up in MaterialDatabase else 1); smithing uses NO diversity multiplier (difficulty_calculator.py:130-175, 290-307)
PARAM INTERPOLATION: normalized = clamp01((points-1)/(80-1)); each param = easy + (hard-easy)×normalized over SMITHING_PARAMS ranges (difficulty_calculator.py:253-283, 66-97)
TEMP BAND DERIVATION: band = temp_ideal_range interpolated (25→3°); centered at 70; min clamped to [55,75], max clamped to [min+3, 85] (difficulty_calculator.py:309-318)
DIFFICULTY TIER LABEL: common 0-4, uncommon 5-10, rare 11-20, epic 21-40, legendary 41+ (difficulty_calculator.py:47-53, 754-772)

FAILURE PENALTY: loss_fraction = 0.3 + clamp01((points-1)/(80-1)) × 0.6 → 30-90% of each input lost; engine consumes that fraction from REAL inventory via consume_materials_partial (crafter's own deduction hits a throwaway dict) (reward_calculator.py:497-519; smithing.py:809-838; game_engine.py:8934-8951)
SUCCESS CONSUMPTION: full inputs consumed by RecipeDatabase.consume_materials in engine, NOT by the crafter (smithing.py:840-843; game_engine.py:8970-8973)

CRAFTED STATS: quality = int(earned_points/max_points × 100) drives generated equipment stats by item_type + station tier; then rarity modifiers from uniform input rarity applied (crafted_stats.py:80-86; smithing.py:845-873)
RARITY GATE: can_craft requires all inputs same rarity (rarity_system.check_rarity_uniformity) plus quantity check (smithing.py:678-709)

INT LAUNCH MODIFIERS (post-construction, pre-start; difficulty_points untouched): int_reduction = min(INT,30) × 0.02; HAMMER_SPEED ×= max(0.4, 1-int_reduction); TEMP_DECAY ×= max(0.5, 1-int_reduction×0.5); time_limit = int(time_limit × min(1.6, 1+int_reduction)) (game_engine.py:4303-4343; Definitions.JSON/stats-calculations.JSON:379-397)

LAUNCH BONUSES: buff_time_bonus = max(quicken[station], quicken[smithing]) + title smithingTime; buff_quality_bonus = max(empower, elevate, pierce) + title smithingQuality; both passed to constructor (game_engine.py:4220-4261, 4280)
COMPLETION DETECTION: engine polls minigame.result != None each frame → _complete_minigame(); update skipped while metadata overlay blocking (game_engine.py:8554-8566)

PLACEMENT MATCHING: UI grid (x,y) 0-indexed → "row,col" 1-indexed (y+1,x+1); both player and recipe maps normalized to bounding box origin (1,1); exact dict equality required; tries station tier down to T1, skipping tiers the placement footprint exceeds (interactive_crafting.py:680-792)
data: placements.JSON/placements-smithing-1.json — 58 entries; each {recipeId, placementMap: {"row,col": materialId}, metadata: {gridSize e.g. "3x3", narrative}}; example: smithing_bamboo_fishing_rod {"2,2":"oak_log","1,3":"oak_log","3,1":"copper_ingot","2,3":"spectral_thread","3,3":"spectral_thread"} (loaded smithing.py:649-672)

recipes.JSON/recipes-smithing-1.json / -2.json / -3.json / recipes-tag-tests.JSON — recipe fields used: recipeId, outputId, outputQty, stationType=='smithing', stationTier, inputs [{itemId|materialId, quantity}], metadata.tags (inheritable tag filter via SmithingTagProcessor) (smithing.py:538-589, 736-746)
Update-N packages: any *recipes*smithing*.json under installed_updates dirs from updates_manifest.json also loaded (smithing.py:591-647)
MaterialDatabase (items.JSON/items-materials-1.JSON) — material.tier per input for difficulty points; missing material defaults tier 1 (difficulty_calculator.py:151-172)

Definitions.JSON/stats-calculations.JSON intelligence block — reductionPerPoint 0.02, maxEffectiveINT 30, smithing.hammerSpeedMultiplier.minimumMultiplier 0.4, tempDecayMultiplier.minimumMultiplier 0.5, timeLimitMultiplier.maximumMultiplier 1.6 (stats-calculations.JSON:379-397; consumed game_engine.py:4308-4343)
rarity_utils.rarity_system — input rarity uniformity check + apply_rarity_modifiers(base_stats, category, rarity) on output (smithing.py:20, 704, 845-873)
constants: HAMMER_BAR_WIDTH = 400 logical px, center = 200 (smithing.py:124, 334)
Timing bins: w = (400/2)/9 ≈ 22.22px; thresholds 0.3w/1w/2w/3w/4w/6w/9w → scores 100/90/80/70/60/50/30, else 0 (smithing.py:254-286)
Temp multiplier k = 0.0433 (= ln2/16; 0.5 at 4° deviation), clamp [0.1, 1.0] (smithing.py:314-320)
Temp decay tick interval = 100 ms wall clock; effective_decay = TEMP_DECAY/(1+speed_bonus) (smithing.py:211-218)
Start temperature 50.0; temp clamp [0, 100]; fan cap 100 (smithing.py:65, 218, 236)

SMITHING_PARAMS (easy→hard): time_limit 60→25s, temp_ideal_range 25→3°, temp_decay_rate 0.3→0.6 per tick, temp_fan_increment 4→1.5, required_hits 3→12, target_width 100→30px (display-only), perfect_width 50→10px (display-only), hammer_speed 3.0→14.0 px/frame (difficulty_calculator.py:66-97)
Interpolation domain: min_points 1.0, max_points 80.0 (difficulty_calculator.py:56-59)
TIER_POINTS {1:1, 2:2, 3:3, 4:4} linear (difficulty_calculator.py:35-40)
Temp band: center 70°C; min clamp [55,75]; max clamp [min+3, 85] (difficulty_calculator.py:311-318)
Performance normalizer: (avg × temp_bonus)/120 with temp_bonus 1.2 if final temp in band else 1.0 (reward_calculator.py:196-199)
FIRST_TRY_BONUS: performance_boost 0.10, eligible_threshold 0.50 (reward_calculator.py:52-62)
REWARD_MULTIPLIER 1.0-2.5; bonus_pct = int(perf × (max_mult-1) × 20) → 0-30%; stat_multiplier = 1 + bonus/100 (reward_calculator.py:28-31, 123-160)
QUALITY_TIERS: [0,.25) Normal, [.25,.5) Fine, [.5,.75) Superior, [.75,.9) Masterwork, [.9,1.01) Legendary (reward_calculator.py:34-40)
FAILURE_PENALTY 0.30-0.90 loss fraction (reward_calculator.py:43-46, 497-519)
Quality-buff conversion: bonus += int(buff_quality_bonus × 10) (smithing.py:436)
INT: 0.02/point, cap 30 pts (60% max); hammer mult floor 0.4, decay mult floor 0.5 (decay uses ×0.5 of reduction), time mult ceiling 1.6 (game_engine.py:4310-4343)
Legacy tier fallback table T1-T4 (only if difficulty_calculator import fails): e.g. T1 time 50s/4 hits/decay 0.4, T4 time 25s/11 hits/decay 1.1 (difficulty_calculator.py:686-717)
Grid sizes by station tier {1:3, 2:5, 3:7, 4:9} (interactive_crafting.py:634, 766)
Engine: 60 FPS fixed (config.py:16; game_engine.py:12008); double-ESC abandon window 1500 ms (game_engine.py:715)
Crafted-stats quality = int(earned/max × 100), default 50 if max<=0 (crafted_stats.py:81-83)
Metadata display max_bonus = 1.0 + difficulty_points × 0.015 (display-only, disagrees with real reward curve) (game_engine.py:9138)
hazards: attempt is initialized to 1 and NEVER incremented anywhere in the codebase — the +0.10 first-try performance boost applies to EVERY smithing craft; preserve this in the port unless intentionally fixing (smithing.py:51; grep: only assignments =1 exist)

calculate_smithing_rewards reads FIRST_TRY_BONUS['performance_boost'] directly, bypassing the per-discipline first_try_bonus() helper (same 0.10 value today, but tuning per_discipline['smithing'] would silently not apply) (reward_calculator.py:205 vs 65-74)

Hammer sweep is per-update-call (px/frame), NOT dt-scaled — porting to a variable-timestep engine changes difficulty; temp decay IS wall-clock (100ms ticks) and timer IS dt-based, so the three clocks are mixed (smithing.py:210-229)

buff_time_bonus is misnamed: it does NOT extend time_limit; it divides temperature decay (speed_bonus). Time extension comes only from the INT modifier at launch (smithing.py:56-59; game_engine.py:4339-4343)

temp_in_ideal reward bonus (×1.2) samples temperature only at the END moment (after last strike), not time-in-band — stats['time_in_ideal_temp'] is tracked but unused for rewards (smithing.py:407, 203-205)

Per-strike final score already includes the temp multiplier; the end-of-game 1.2 temp bonus is a SECOND, separate temperature reward — do not double-apply or drop either (smithing.py:344, 409-410; reward_calculator.py:196-199)

TARGET_WIDTH / PERFECT_WIDTH are vestigial: rendered as anvil zone lines but scoring ignores them (binned zones instead); visual guides do not match actual bins (difficulty_calculator.py:85-91; game_engine.py:9398-9413)
Double-ESC abandon sets active_minigame=None WITHOUT consuming materials — the 'materials lost' warning text is false; abandon is actually free (game_engine.py:709-726)

Failure material loss: crafter's craft_with_minigame deducts from the throwaway inv_dict; the authoritative deduction is engine consume_materials_partial(loss_fraction) — implement loss exactly once (smithing.py:820-831; game_engine.py:8944-8951)

int(round(...)) on strike score means a 100-timing strike slightly out of temp band can still show 100 only if temp_mult rounds up (e.g. 0.996+); score categories use final (post-temp) score so 'perfect_strikes' requires >=100 (smithing.py:344, 355-356)
Strike with timing score 0 still consumes a hit (hammer_hits increments on any STRIKE click) — spamming the button burns required hits with zeros (smithing.py:369-370)
end() success path with zero strikes guards div-by-zero (avg=0) but is unreachable since completion requires REQUIRED_HITS>0 (smithing.py:404)
Minigame update (and thus timer) is frozen while the metadata intro overlay blocks — do not start the countdown until the overlay dismisses (game_engine.py:8556-8558)
last_temp_update starts at 0 in __init__ but is reset to now in start(); calling update() before start() would apply a huge first decay tick — always start() first (smithing.py:71, 170)
duplicate get_placement defined twice on SmithingCrafter; the second (returns {} default) wins — Python quirk, harmless, but port only one (smithing.py:674-676 vs 927-929)

Placement file referenced as .JSON while on-disk file is .json — works on case-insensitive Windows; a case-sensitive port must normalize (smithing.py:653-658; dir listing shows placements-smithing-1.json)

Difficulty tier label gap: get_difficulty_tier misses non-integer points in threshold gaps (e.g. 4.5 falls between common(0-4) and uncommon(5-10) → returns 'common' via fallback); points are float sums so this occurs (difficulty_calculator.py:47-53, 754-772)

Inputs accept both 'itemId' (new) and 'materialId' (legacy) keys — support both when reading recipes; difficulty calc checks materialId first, can_craft checks itemId first (smithing.py:698, 824; difficulty_calculator.py:161)
INT modifiers mutate the constructed minigame's params in-place AFTER construction but do NOT touch difficulty_points, so rewards stay difficulty-true; keep that ordering (game_engine.py:4303-4343)

Fallback legacy reward branch (score>=140 thresholds) is dead code unless reward_calculator import fails — score max is 100 so 140 is unreachable; do not port thresholds as live logic (smithing.py:462-491)
